findings.quoted_text: Company will create and provide to Reed's the Deliverables. Reed's will exclusively own all Deliverables. Company will and hereby does, without further consideration, irrevocably assign to Reed's any and all worldwide right, title or interest that Company may now or hereafter possess in or to the Deliverables in perpetuity

EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS SET FORTH IN SECTION 9 WITH REGARD TO CLAIMS BY THIRD PARTIES, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE FOR CONSEQUENTIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE OR ENHANCED DAMAGES, LOST PROFITS OR REVENUES OR DIMINUTION IN VALUE ARISING OUT OF, RELATING TO, OR IN CONNECTION WITH ANY BREACH OF THIS AGREEMENT
Company shall be responsible for all costs relating to the development of the Recipes and Deliverables, except for costs and expenses relating to the involvement of Reed's personnel and contractors.

Company will create and provide to [PARTY_D] the Deliverables. [PARTY_D] will exclusively own all Deliverables. Company will and hereby does, without further consideration, irrevocably assign to [PARTY_D] any and all worldwide right, title or interest that Company may now or hereafter possess in or to the Deliverables in perpetuity
findings.explanation: You assign all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables immediately upon creation, while your sole compensation is tied to a separate, concurrent Manufacturing and Distribution Agreement rather than guaranteed payment.
findings.suggested_change: Modify the clause to state that intellectual property assignment is conditioned upon the successful execution and ongoing performance of the Manufacturing and Distribution Agreement.

findings.quoted_text: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS SET FORTH IN SECTION 9 WITH REGARD TO CLAIMS BY THIRD PARTIES, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE FOR CONSEQUENTIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, PUNITIVE OR ENHANCED DAMAGES, LOST PROFITS OR REVENUES OR DIMINUTION IN VALUE ARISING OUT OF, RELATING TO, OR IN CONNECTION WITH ANY BREACH OF THIS AGREEMENT
findings.explanation: The waiver of consequential and indirect damages explicitly excludes indemnification claims under Section 9, leaving your liability completely uncapped and exposed to severe third-party claims.
findings.suggested_change: Remove the carve-out for indemnification from the limitation of liability clause and establish a reasonable overall monetary cap on liability for both parties.

findings.quoted_text: Company shall be responsible for all costs relating to the development of the Recipes and Deliverables, except for costs and expenses relating to the involvement of [PARTY_D] personnel and contractors.
findings.explanation: You bear all costs for development while the specifications are left open-ended for the Development Committee to decide, creating risk for endless revisions and uncompensated work.
findings.suggested_change: Explicitly define the scope and maximum number of recipe iterations included in the development phase, and require additional compensation for extra work requested by the Development Committee.

findings.quoted_text: In exchange for Company's contributions and obligations under this Agreement, [PARTY_D] grants Company the exclusive right to manufacture, package, promote, sell and distribute the Products (if and to the extent approved by the Development Committee), subject to the terms and conditions of a separate Manufacturing and Distribution Agreement to be entered into by the parties concurrently with this Agreement... Company shall be responsible for all costs relating to the development of the Recipes and Deliverables
findings.explanation: You are required to absorb all development costs out of pocket with no guaranteed base fee or cash compensation under this agreement, relying entirely on contingent future manufacturing rights.
findings.suggested_change: Negotiate an upfront development fee or milestone payments to cover your labor and out-of-pocket costs regardless of whether manufacturing begins.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to our collaboration, and I would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the intellectual property clause, rights are assigned immediately upon creation while compensation is tied to a separate agreement; I propose to modify the agreement to state that intellectual property assignment is conditioned upon the successful execution and ongoing performance of the Manufacturing and Distribution Agreement. - Regarding the limitation of liability, the waiver of consequential and indirect damages excludes indemnification claims, leaving liability exposed; I propose to remove the carve-out for indemnification from the limitation of liability clause and establish a reasonable overall monetary cap on liability for both parties. - Regarding the development costs, all costs are borne for development while specifications are open-ended, creating risk for uncompensated work; I propose to explicitly define the scope and maximum number of recipe iterations included in the development phase, and require additional compensation for extra work requested by the Development Committee. Please let me know if these adjustments work for you so we can finalize the paperwork. Best regards,
